title: Deduplicate boxed-report framing
prompt: report.mjs contains two functions, formatUserReport and formatOrderReport, that duplicate the same boxed-report framing logic (border building, title row, padded body rows). Refactor report.mjs so the shared framing exists exactly once — e.g. extract a helper that both functions call. The rendered output must stay byte-identical: check.mjs asserts the exact strings AND that the duplicated border expression `"+" + "-".repeat(width) + "+"` appears at most once in the source. Verify with `node check.mjs` (exit code 0 means done).
